Package com.neueda.leap.order.service

Class OrderExecutionService

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.order.service.OrderExecutionService
@Service public class OrderExecutionService extends Object
Processes due orders using current bid/ask quotes and a midpoint tolerance. BUY orders use ask; other sides use bid. The order buffer overrides the account buffer. Missing quotes retry after ten seconds and stale quotes after five, without increasing the tolerance-failure count. Out-of-tolerance prices retry with capped exponential backoff and reject on the tenth tolerance failure. A fill writes cash and holdings ledger entries and a status-history record.

The batch method calls execution methods on this instance. Their transactional annotations require invocation through a transaction interceptor; internal calls alone do not create a Spring proxy transaction.

    • executeOrder

      public void executeOrder(Order order)
      Attempts to fill an order using the latest quote. A missing or stale quote defers execution; an out-of-tolerance price retries or rejects. A successful attempt persists a fill, settlement ledger entries and FILLED status.
      Parameters:
      order - order with populated account, instrument, side, quantity and attempt count

      protected BigDecimal getExecutionPrice(Order order, Quote quote)
      Determine execution price based on order side and quote. For BUY: use ASK price (seller's price) For SELL: use BID price (buyer's price)
      Parameters:
      order - order being executed
      quote - selected quote, or null when unavailable
      Returns:
      ask for BUY, otherwise bid

    • isPriceWithinTolerance

      protected boolean isPriceWithinTolerance(Order order, Quote quote, BigDecimal executionPrice)
      Validate price is within tolerance buffer. BR-08: Execution price must be within tolerance of the midpoint. Tolerance = account's execution_buffer_percent (or order's buffer_percent if set). For BUY orders: ask <= midpoint × (1 + buffer% / 100) For SELL orders: bid >= midpoint × (1 - buffer% / 100)
      Parameters:
      order - order being executed
      quote - selected quote, or null when unavailable
      executionPrice - execution price per unit
      Returns:
      whether the side-specific execution price is within the midpoint tolerance
